name: Minimap
description: A shaded minimap of the terrain around you: relief lighting, water depth, cave view, chunk grid and waypoints, drawn in a single draw call.
author: Perlin

settings.label: Show minimap
settings.description: Also bound to a key (Toggle minimap).

settings.label: Size
settings.description: Width and height on screen, in gui pixels.

settings.label: Zoom
settings.description: Higher is closer. The zoom keys step through 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 and the map eases between them.

settings.label: Rotate with player
settings.description: Keep where you look at the top instead of north.

settings.label: Relief lighting
settings.description: How strongly slopes and height show: slopes facing the light are brightened, the others shaded, and higher ground is lighter.

settings.label: Sun shadows
settings.description: Slopes are lit from where the sun or moon is, so shadows move through the day.

settings.label: Day and night
settings.description: The map darkens at night like the world does.

settings.label: Cave view
settings.description: Underground the map shows the floor of the layer you are in instead of the surface.

settings.label: Cave zoom
settings.description: Multiplies the zoom while the cave view is showing, up to 6.
